scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @proxi/api && npm run build --workspace @proxi/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @proxi/api" "npm run dev --workspace @proxi/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @proxi/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @proxi/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @proxi/api && npm run test --workspace @proxi/web
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspace @proxi/api && npm run test:coverage --workspace @proxi/web
